name: auron
description: AURON — RWA + DeFi + stablecoin credit infrastructure POC

scripts.setup: npm run build -w @auron/config && npm run build -w @auron/sdk
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @auron/api" "npm run dev -w @auron/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run setup && npm run dev -w @auron/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run setup && npm run dev -w @auron/web
scripts.build: npm run setup && npm run build -w @auron/api && npm run build -w @auron/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @auron/config && npm run lint -w @auron/sdk && npm run lint -w @auron/api && npm run lint -w @auron/web
